spatial_reference: Upper/lower name the two fixed WR05 open-shelf levels. Either side beside the serving plate is a valid staging location; the expert's recorded left/right assignment is not part of the task label.

pick_ketchup_lower.label: pick up the ketchup bottle from the lower shelf

pick_ketchup_upper.label: pick up the ketchup bottle from the upper shelf

place_ketchup_plate.label: place the ketchup bottle beside the serving plate

pick_mustard_lower.label: pick up the mustard bottle from the lower shelf

pick_mustard_upper.label: pick up the mustard bottle from the upper shelf

place_mustard_plate.label: place the mustard bottle beside the serving plate

pick_ketchup_plate.label: pick up the ketchup bottle from beside the serving plate

return_ketchup_lower.label: return the ketchup bottle upright to the lower shelf

return_ketchup_upper.label: return the ketchup bottle upright to the upper shelf

pick_mustard_plate.label: pick up the mustard bottle from beside the serving plate

return_mustard_lower.label: return the mustard bottle upright to the lower shelf

return_mustard_upper.label: return the mustard bottle upright to the upper shelf
